sections.title: Objective and authority
sections.content: Plan the vdd-conformance-exact-cover capability as a deterministic, read-only consumer proving sound-and-complete coverage between a VDD-frozen Canonical Spec Package and execution-plan requirements. bmad-spec owns the package descriptor and external selection registry; VDD owns source freeze, create/repair, draft, and plan-ready; the maintainer authorization adapter alone owns implementation authorization.

sections.title: Required delivery order
sections.content: First upgrade bmad-spec create/refresh/validation to emit the typed canonical-spec-package.v1 descriptor and atomically publish a content-addressed selection record plus current pointer. Then add minimal VDD source-freeze production and repair-input consumption, implement exact-cover against the same frozen identity, and finally add current-receipt preflight to the existing authorization boundary.

sections.title: Canonical contracts
sections.content: Use repository-canonical-json.v1, explicit domain-separated hash envelopes, artifact-specific self-hash projections, repository-relative POSIX paths, deterministic UTF-8 ordering, raw-byte file hashes, and independently reconstructable manifests. Preserve the exact newline-delimited vcec-shard-v1 identity as the sole non-JSON hash exception. Unknown schemas, duplicate keys, invalid paths, role drift, omissions, stale hashes, or caller-reduced authority universes fail closed.

sections.title: Coverage and semantic boundaries
sections.content: Deterministically validate schema, paths, identities, roles, sets, mappings, dispositions, and bidirectional obligation-requirement-acceptance coverage before semantic work. LLM output may propose anchored obligation candidates or explain ambiguity but cannot assign canonical identity, decide coverage, or produce PASS. Only a structurally complete, source-bound ambiguity may yield requirement_semantic_review_required for explicitly authorized bootstrap-upstream-plan review.

sections.title: Fingerprints, policy, and bounded output
sections.content: Bind each run to the complete aggregate fingerprint and each reusable shard to the exact shard-level fingerprint. Global drift invalidates aggregate results and receipts; relevant shard drift invalidates only affected extraction, while unchanged reuse requires current-manifest proof. Runtime retry, partition, quarantine, and presentation values must come from an approved versioned registry profile. The sole model-visible hard gate is 12000 exact serialized UTF-8 bytes; token count is telemetry only.

sections.title: Recovery and authority isolation
sections.content: Use append-only recovery-checkpoint.v1 lineages with explicit branch authorization, exact sequence progression, immutable validator and policy identities, complete content-addressed artifact references, stage-tagged bindings, and typed live blockers. Resume selects the greatest validated sequence on the authorized lineage and re-hashes all bindings. Exact-cover outputs diagnostics, handoffs, checkpoints, and receipts with authorizes empty; it never mutates the target or publishes lifecycle, acceptance, release, or commit state.

sections.title: Verification scope
sections.content: The execution plan must cover schemas and golden vectors, package and source-freeze producer-consumer composition, deterministic negative and mutation fixtures, bounded retry and stop-loss, shard reuse and quarantine, semantic handoff and explicit VDD repair, stale-evidence invalidation, authorization preflight, cross-process recovery, target-byte immutability, and at least one full create-to-rerun dogfood flow. Stable requirements VCEC-001 through VCEC-036 and acceptances VCEC-A01 through VCEC-A43 form the traceability baseline.
